messages:
sam: Quick status check — where are we on the kernel PRs + KV warmup + continuous batching perf? Need any cross-team unblockers for the end-of-sprint demo?

tara: PR #482 is ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482. Left a couple notes about tensor copy semantics. CI is flaky on the GPU matrix multiply test though.

cheng: Continuous batching branch (local) shows ~12% median latency drop on toy workloads but node0 CPU climbs while batching ramps. Investigating where the extra memcpy happens.

matt: I can take a pass on #482 today. Tara — can you add a minimal repro (input shape + cfg) so I can reproduce the tensor copy concern locally? :eyes:

anya: KV warmup change landed on dev yesterday but hasn't been promoted to canary. Ops asked to schedule a rollout window because evictions look slightly aggressive in staging.

sam: Thanks — quick owners callout: kernel = tara, continuous-batching = cheng, kv-warmup = anya. If we can get reviews + canary runs this week we should be good for demo.

ci-bot: Build status — PR #482: linux-x86 ✅, gpu-runner ⚠ flaky on `matmul_gpu_test`. Retrigger with `/retest` when updated.

tara: repro added to PR now (small script + config). matt, included exact shapes and a short trace. Also added `--no-simd` toggles in case it's hardware-specific.

matt: grabbing it now. If CI flakes, I'll run the GPU test matrix locally with `docker --gpus all` and share logs.

cheng: I pushed a micro-opt to avoid one memcpy in the batching hot path. Small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/489. Bench script: 

```
./bench/continuous_batch --model tiny --seq 256 --batch-window 20ms --iters 100
```

We're seeing improvement but need to confirm with canary.

anya: I'll coordinate with eng-sre for a 30-min canary window tomorrow 09:30 PT. If results look stable, I'll promote to canary->prod after a smoke check. @eng-sre please ack. :thumbsup:

sam: Action items:
- matt: review #482 (kernel) today, reply with blocking comments (owner: matt, due: EOD today).
- cheng: run canary perf with the bench script and post results (owner: cheng, due: tomorrow morning).
- anya: schedule rollout window and get eng-sre ack (owner: anya, due: tomorrow AM).
- tara: address any follow-up from matt and CI flakes (owner: tara, due: tomorrow).

sam: Ping here when each item is done so I can update the sprint board. If any cross-team deps surface (platform image, infra config), call them out in-thread and tag owners.

anya: noted — will open a short infra ticket if we need a new runtime image tag; otherwise just promote current canary.

matt: Starting review now. If I hit a blocker I'll post a quick snippet of failing test and CC infra.

sam: Great — appreciate the quick coordination. :rocket:
